selection: SelFix official FLUX.1-dev implementation, with both author editing defaults and a separately labeled high-fidelity inversion budget
claim_scope: recent SOTA candidate with public method, code and reconstruction/editing evidence; not a claim of a unique globally best or chronologically newest editor

sources.name: SelFix
sources.method: Root selection through a straightness anchor, vanishing harmonic weight and decoupled fixed-point momentum; original FireFlow-style value injection for editing
evidence_read: official solver and feature injection source
sources.choice: selected; native FLUX weights already local and fully auditable

sources.name: SlerpFlow
sources.method: Spherical correction of RF velocities with caching
sources.choice: reviewed; prioritise the fixed-point high-fidelity route for this test, not maximum first-order efficiency; paper scores across budgets are not directly comparable

sources.name: DirectEdit
sources.method: Step-level source/reconstruction alignment with attention injection and multi-branch mask blending
sources.choice: reviewed; different full preservation pipeline, not substituted by an incomplete hand-coded version

sources.name: SteerFlow
sources.method: Amortised fixed-point inversion, source/target trajectory interpolation and adaptive masking
sources.choice: reviewed; current test prefers a pinned directly reusable public implementation

sources.name: FlashIn
sources.method: Learned one-step inversion with cycle and adversarial training
sources.choice: reviewed; requires a different pretrained inversion network/backbone configuration

sources.name: FlowEdit
sources.method: Source-anchored velocity difference under repeatedly sampled source noise; n_min=0 clean edit integration
sources.choice: rerun on the SAME native FLUX model and image resolution as SelFix
